settings.title: Settings
hotkeys.tip: Click a box, then press a key, a mouse button or a controller button. Esc cancels, Delete clears. The game still gets every key.
hotkeys.padTip: Controllers: Xbox, PlayStation (DualSense, DualShock 4) and most others, with no extra app. On PlayStation, Cross is A, Circle B, Square X and Triangle Y.
options.startOnChangeTip: Switching to the other timer stops the one you leave and starts the new one.
options.transparentTip: Only the numbers show, with a thin outline in the Background color.
options.clickthroughTip: Clicks go through the timer to the game. Turn it off from the tray icon. It is always off when the timer starts.
options.resizeTip: Drag the timer to move it, or drag its edges or corner to resize it.
colors.last20Tip: Timer 2, in the last 20 seconds before it reaches Timer 1's time.
general.installedOnly: Updates work in the installed app.
update.failed: The update could not be downloaded
general.resetTip: Hotkeys, options and colors go back to how they started.
